name: Teusajaure-Vakkotavare
estimatedTime: 4-6 hours by STF; 5-6 or 5-7 hours in other official/secondary evidence
description: Teusajaure to Vakkotavare. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Teusajaure hut water: Water fetched from stream/lake at hut; not indoor treated tap water.
Guolbbanjohka bridge / stream water: Stream/bridge water point on the route; OSM tags drinking water but treat/filter as natural stream water.
notes: Route geometry is land-only candidate linework. The Teusajaure lake crossing is required and must be planned as scheduled boat or rowboat transport, not as continuous hiking geometry.
STF Swedish route gives 4-6 hours; Naturkartan gives 5-6 hours; rules lane saw STF stage as 5-7 hours and field lane notes secondary guides often say 5-7.

STF boat page still carried 2025 update/dates and listed Teusajaure service June 19-September 14, while 2026 hut dates end September 13. Rowboats normally deployed around midsummer/no later than July 1 and removed late September.

Naturkartan text includes the 1 km boat crossing in the route description and 15 km distance, but API linework excludes it and stores only 13.845 km land line reversed. OSM relation includes ferry/rowing segment.
Current STF route says no shop/carry food and current STF shop list omits Vakkotavare, while older field report mentioned basic goods/souvenirs.
Some wording is looser about using dried branches/twigs, while Laponia web says fires only at designated fireplaces. Fire bans override either.
General national-park guidance allows short tenting, but STF says Vakkotavare has no own tent sites and field reports say roadhead space is poor.
